hero.heading: A ten-storied campus, one mission: capable citizens for the 21st century.
hero.subheading: From Play Group to Grade Twelve, in Bangla and English, K C Model School & College has grown from 2,200 students in 2015 to 2,336 today.

about.heading: Background & Heritage
about.body: K C Model School & College (KCMSC) was founded in 2014 by Al-Hajj Md. Khashru Chowdhury (CIP), founder of Nipa Group, near Uttara at 275 Prembagan, Dakshinkhan, Dhaka-1230. Housed in a ten-storied building, KCMSC began its journey on 1 January 2015 with 2,200 students and now offers both Bangla and English Versions of the National Curriculum from Play Group through Grade Twelve.
about.mission: KCMSC empowers students from Play Group to Grade Twelve to discover and maximize their physical, mental, and spiritual potential through rigorous national curricula, innovative teaching, and guidance from expert faculty.
about.vision: To be the premier institution in Bangladesh, realizing our founder's dream of nurturing capable, responsible global citizens equipped to excel in the 21st century.

academicsPage.heading: Academics
academicsPage.intro: KCMSC follows a dual-wing structure under unified leadership: a Junior Wing covering Pre-Primary and Primary education, and a Senior Wing covering Secondary and Higher Secondary education. Both wings offer Bangla and English Versions of the National Curriculum.

studentLifePage.heading: Student Life
studentLifePage.intro: Co-curricular activities are directed by the school's Cultural Department and integrated into the academic framework across both wings.

coCurricular.title: Visual Arts
coCurricular.items: Drawing and painting, including themes of the Liberation War and Bangladesh's seasons

culturalEducation.title: National Legacy Celebrations
culturalEducation.body: International Mother Language Day, Independence Day, Victory Day, and Pahela Baishakh, marked with patriotic songs, traditional dance, thematic dramas, and poetry recitation.

culturalEducation.title: Literary Tributes
culturalEducation.body: Rabindra-Nazrul Jayanti celebrations through musical performances, recitation competitions, and staged interpretations of literary classics.

culturalEducation.title: Heritage Immersion
culturalEducation.body: Cultural fairs and Pitha Utsab (a traditional food festival), folk game revivals such as Ha-du-du and Gollachut, and showcases of Bengali attire, handicrafts, and music.

highlights: Student participation in the "Safe Roads Movement" road-safety initiative
Students plant and maintain the rooftop gardens themselves as part of hands-on botany learning
Junior Wing co-curricular classes cover traffic rules, personal health awareness, dengue-prevention posters, and self-protection guidance

rooftopGarden.heading: Rooftop Garden
rooftopGarden.body: KCMSC has created gardens on the rooftops of its four ten-storied buildings, growing fruit-bearing trees, vegetables, and native and foreign flowering plants. Students plant and care for the trees themselves, gaining practical knowledge while the gardens help maintain the balance of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the local environment.

clubsPage.heading: Clubs & Activities
clubsPage.intro: Facilities at KCMSC support a range of student-run and faculty-guided clubs.

clubs.name: Music Club
clubs.description: Instruments including piano, guitar, and tabla.

clubs.name: Alumni Association
clubs.description: Reunions, career talks, and mentorship programs connecting alumni with current students. 50 active members as of the most recent count.

facilitiesPage.heading: Campus & Facilities
facilitiesPage.intro: KCMSC's ten-storied campus houses academic, cultural, and welfare facilities for students from Play Group to Grade Twelve.
general: Air-conditioned computer lab (50+ PCs, high-speed internet)
Science labs — Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Mathematics
Library with 10,000+ books and digital resources
Sports Club — cricket, football, and basketball courts
KC Information and Communication Club (KCICT) — robotics and coding
Scout Troop — community service and leadership
studentFacilities: Two modern, air-conditioned computer labs; separate, fully equipped laboratories for Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Agricultural Science
Two separate library rooms for primary and secondary level students
Classes conducted with projectors and laptops
Modern toilets with round-the-clock cleaning services
Classrooms with ample natural light and ventilation
High-capacity backup generator system for power outages
Advanced water purification filters on every floor
Residential facilities for students living in remote areas
A childcare centre for working mothers
Security and academic activities monitored through CCTV surveillance

rooftopGarden.heading: Rooftop Garden
rooftopGarden.body: Gardens on the rooftops of KCMSC's four ten-storied buildings grow fruit-bearing trees, vegetables, and native and foreign flowering plants. Students plant and maintain the trees themselves, gaining hands-on agricultural knowledge while the gardens contribute to the balance of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the surrounding area.
